subject.title: skill_workshop: quarantined proposals are CLI dead-ends (no apply/revise/reject path back)

question: Which recovery transition, if any, should Skill Workshop support for quarantined proposals?
rationale: Current docs and tests intentionally make non-pending proposals terminal, and changing quarantined recovery affects safety semantics plus public CLI, tool, Gateway, and UI behavior.

options.title: Add audited quarantine recovery
options.body: Support a bounded path such as reject-from-quarantined plus revise-to-pending after a fresh scan, with docs and tests across every public surface.

options.title: Unify with restore semantics
options.body: Wait for the rejected-proposal restore direction to settle, then extend the same public lifecycle model to quarantined proposals if maintainers want one recovery verb.

options.title: Keep quarantine terminal
options.body: Treat quarantined proposals as immutable safety holds and document recreation or manual dismissal as the supported operator path.

recommendation.title: Add audited quarantine recovery
recommendation.body: Support a bounded path such as reject-from-quarantined plus revise-to-pending after a fresh scan, with docs and tests across every public surface.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest current signal for Skill Workshop lifecycle internals and product/API coordination.
